patents.patent_title: Machine learning model compression using knowledge distillation
patents.patent_abstract: A method for compressing deep neural network models by transferring knowledge from a large teacher network to a smaller student network using soft probability targets.

patents.patent_title: Federated learning system for distributed model training
patents.patent_abstract: A system enabling multiple edge devices to collaboratively train a shared neural network model without sharing raw data, preserving user privacy.

patents.patent_title: Attention mechanism for natural language processing
patents.patent_abstract: A transformer-based self-attention mechanism that computes contextual representations of tokens in a sequence for downstream NLP classification tasks.

patents.patent_title: Automated hyperparameter optimisation using Bayesian search
patents.patent_abstract: A method for selecting optimal neural network hyperparameters by modelling the objective function as a Gaussian process and using acquisition functions to guide search.

patents.patent_title: Graph neural network for molecular property prediction
patents.patent_abstract: A graph convolutional network architecture that encodes molecular graphs and predicts chemical properties useful in drug discovery pipelines.
